title: test_landing: vision-based autonomous following and landing of a UAV on a moving ground platform
description:
ROS code that lets a multirotor UAV detect, follow and land on a moving unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) using ArUco fiducial markers and a single on-board camera. It accompanies the article: J. Morales, I. Castelo, R. Serra, P. U. Lima and M. Basiri, "Vision-Based Autonomous Following of a Moving Platform and Landing for an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle", Sensors, vol. 23, no. 2, 829, 2023, https://doi.org/10.3390/s23020829.

The code was written in June and July 2022 at the Institute for Systems and Robotics (ISR/LARSyS) of Instituto Superior Técnico, Lisbon, within the EU project DURABLE. It is research code released as is, to document the method and make the experiments reproducible.

The code is released under the BSD 3-Clause License. The directory models/iris_camera contains a third-party Gazebo model derived from the ArduPilot Gazebo plugin and is redistributed under its original GPL-3.0 licence.
